title: Policy-Governed Route Decisions
summary: The WLU Route Decision Gate uses a shared institutional policy to determine if a scheduler may act on an advisory recommendation.
why: Ensures that the transition from 'evidence-based advice' to 'actual execution' is governed by a reviewed and approved institutional policy.
invariants: The Decision Gate has no WLU authority (cannot reserve/spend WLU).
Policy Rules: DENY, RECOMMENDED_ONLY, EVIDENCE_ELIGIBLE, DECLARED_CANDIDATE.
Actors: AUTOMATED and OPERATOR may have different permissible rule sets.
A 'PERMITTED' decision is not an admission; it is a permission to proceed to the ordinary WLU admission path.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:290-315. Line 305: 'A PERMITTED decision means only that the fixed institutional route-selection policy permits the external scheduler to proceed to the ordinary WLU admission path.'
